summary: 3.1D schedule UI refinement: Date Override is now a vertical 24-hour list with WEEKLY/OVERRIDE/EMPTY badges, +N detail indicators, date navigation and a shared content picker, and the schedule page no longer lets a slow response repaint or write into the wrong profile, date or hour. No migrations, requirements/packages, systemd, nginx, static or protected-runtime changes. Only Gunicorn restarts; the engine is unchanged.
